svg.title: CASTAWAY: Welcome to my Island Homepage!!!
svg.desc: A late-1990s personal homepage for Castaway, a ten-hour lo-fi island video: a starry tiled background, a yellow serif welcome line, CASTAWAY in fat 3D rainbow letters, a scrolling rainbow rule, an annotated photo of the island with her nodding to the music, a NEW! starburst, a tumbling message in a bottle, an under-construction sign with flashing lamps, and a marquee.
